purpose: Generate broadly, score rigorously, reject weak anecdote-only or mechanism-only ideas, require a concrete historical story core, support character-led, event-led and world-led storytelling, and preserve channel diversity.

storyModes.defaultSelectionRule: Choose the mode that best fits the topic; never invent or force a protagonist just to satisfy a template.
storyModes.characterLed: A recurring historical person is the main narrative spine.
storyModes.eventLed: A concrete event, crisis, conflict or sequence is the spine; different people or groups may carry different beats.
storyModes.worldLed: A place, system, everyday practice, technology, institution or historical world is the spine; representative historical people may appear without becoming recurring protagonists.

forbiddenDefaults: famous person plus weird anecdote plus trick as automatic choice
forcing a named protagonist into an event-led or world-led topic
mechanism-only topic presented as a historical story
nature event followed by a chain of explanatory diagrams with weak human story
technology function explanation without concrete historical stakes
three Rome or Antiquity topics in direct succession
topic is interesting only because of exaggerated clickbait
visually monotonous topic with no compensating story strength
weak source base for the central claim
